title: Thank You | Duke Gallo
description: Thanks for reaching out to Duke Gallo. Your message was received and Duke will be in touch soon, usually within one business day of your submission.
body_html:
Message received

Thanks for reaching out

Your message is on its way to me, and I'll get back to you soon, usually the same business day.

If it's time-sensitive, call or text me at (949) 688-5959.

In the meantime, you might find something useful on the blog.
